purpose: Full development-skill and user-plugin parity for the Mac mini, plus explicitly requested additions. Sanitized metadata, not an executable installer.
limitations: Observed installed hashes are not proof of upstream Git revisions.
The authoring worktree is unpublished; use the approved published SHA, never this metadata snapshot as release approval.
Native-app skills, MCP authorization, GUI permissions, plugins and referenced agent definitions require separate provisioning.
Project scopes stay project scopes. Missing/unknown provenance must remain visible in the completion report.
No credentials, environment values, full settings files or third-party skill bodies are included.
